metadata.description: Saved function 'Nutanix' - a normalized, friendly view over Nutanix_CL for use in analytics rules, hunting, and workbooks. Deploy once; reference as Nutanix(...) or just Nutanix in KQL.
Name of the Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.

properties.query:
Nutanix_CL
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Category,
    Severity = tolower(Severity),
    Operation = OperationType,
    Title,
    Message,
    Actor = ActorUser,
    Cluster = NutanixClusterName,
    ClusterUuid = NutanixClusterUuid,
    EntityType = tolower(SourceEntityType),
    EntityUuid = SourceEntityUuid,
    AffectedEntities,
    RawPayload,
    IngestId
